results.name: Spacesuit (Confederation of Planets)
results.description:
Standard spacesuit of the Confederation of Planets (CoP). Game-ready model, intended to use in a game with third-person view. Proportions and character head inside helmet was taken from Adobe FUSE standard human model.

Download FREE AccuRIG auto-rigging tool: https://actorcore.reallusion.com/auto-rig

results.name: Rust Space Suit
results.description:
The Space Suit from the game Rust.

The suit seems to be a mix of The Russian Berkut Space suit and the some parts from the Apollo A7L and A7L-B suit.

Note: The textures were AI upscaled

results.name: Mercenary Astronaut
results.description:
Mercenary Astronaut 3d model. This model was started a couple years ago for the never finished and never published another yet nonamed Indi Project. And it was staying on my hdd disk with work-in-progress condition. You know, when you start some project, and never finish it. So I thought it needed to be done. Because this model I did with big time gaps, it needs to be retextured and remodelled some parts.. I'm not satisfied yet, but I think it must be finished anyway. So I hope you like it.
It is absolutely free for your game or CG project, you can use it freely..
Textures are overweight, 4096px, and it can be decreased to the smallest one.
Model consists of some stuff and it can be turned off. Pauldrons, backpack cargo boxes, iron cargo boxes, antenna and fonar, back frame for cargo, can be disabled, for customization.
I hope you liked it!

results.name: Space Engineer F Rigged
results.description:
A protection suit meant for relatively hostile environment.
Good for crowds or at some distance from the camera. Nice amount of verts. One texture set.
The rig includes twist bones. Tested and works well.

The face mesh can easily be replaced, and you can utilise the face bones as well.

The helmet and backpack can be found in the catalog.
![](https://tegnemaskin.no/gfx/astrolady-04.jpg)

results.name: Steven Universe: The Space Race
results.description:
I really enjoyed this episode as it had some pretty backgrounds and i also thought the spaceship and flight suit pearls costume were pretty neat! 

If you have low FPS or want a more simple view like for VR, you can try this version!: https://skfb.ly/6nFAE

I'm a sucker for night time looking maps as i enjoy setting up the sky, and playing around with sketchfabs neat options, I also modeled Pearls flight suit and included her in the ship.

The FBX files for flight suit Pearl and the Universe Mach 3 ship can be found in the SOURCE FILES zip
